description: This file defines classes and types related to PWM signal management, including SingleWave and MultiWave classes for handling digital signal sequences and their timing. It includes definitions for pin states, and declares methods for initializing, manipulating, and accessing wave data for embedded firmware controlling PWM output channels.

classes.name: SingleWave
classes.description: Represents a sequence of digital signal states (HIGH or LOW) for a single PWM channel, allowing initialization and access to individual states.

classes.name: MultiWave
classes.description: Represents multiple channels of PWM signals with shared time axes, providing methods to manage switch times and retrieve channel states.

methods.description: Constructor for SingleWave initialized with pin states

methods.description: Initialize or reinitialize the wave with pin states

methods.name: pin_state_t getState(int switchIndex)
methods.description: Retrieve the signal state at specified index

methods.name: void setState(int switchIndex, pin_state_t state)
methods.description: Set the signal state at specified index
